member.name: OdooCommand
member.summary: Commands for writing one2many and many2many fields, e.g. model["tag_ids"] = OdooCommand.Set(1, 2). Odoo 13+ accepts also a plain list of ids for many2many fields; older versions need commands.

member.name: Create
member.summary: Creates a new related record from and links it: [[0, 0, values]].
member.param: Field values of the new record.

member.name: Update
member.summary: Updates the related record with : [[1, id, values]].

member.name: Delete
member.summary: Removes the related record from the field and deletes it from the database: [[2, id, 0]].

member.name: Unlink
member.summary: Removes the related record from the field, the record stays in the database: [[3, id, 0]].

member.name: Link
member.summary: Adds the existing record to the field: [[4, id, 0]].

member.name: Clear
member.summary: Removes all records from the field, the records stay in the database: [[5, 0, 0]].

member.name: Set
member.summary: Replaces all records in the field with : [[6, 0, ids]].
